findings.issue: Qal passive participle is one word; tsaráat is an untranslated common noun (not the token, and not a proper name).
Qal imperfect is 3fs, so the one that goes out is the feminine noun; «varón que saliere» makes the man the subject who goes out.
Morphology is preposition plus suffix 1st common plural; él is 3rd masculine singular.
Qal imperfect 3ms is stative be/become clean; se limpie can be read as the subject cleansing himself.
yacimiento often means a site or deposit and can add a place; the token is only the feminine construct noun before seed.

notes: Repeated איש איש, מזרע אהרן, לא יאכל, and construct טמא נפש stay open.
